basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old living in the bustling city of New York. By day, I'm a web developer navigating the fast-paced world of tech, and by night, I'm diving into the world of Reddit to learn and connect. Originally from Malaysia, I moved to the US a couple of years ago. I have a keen interest in technology and gaming, with a particular love for flight simulators like War Thunder. I also have a fascination with the supernatural and enjoy reading ghost stories in my spare time. As someone trying to expand my social circle, I often explore different subreddits related to hobbies and locations. Engaged to my college sweetheart, I'm navigating the exciting yet complex journey of planning a wedding. Despite my tech-savvy nature, I enjoy the occasional offline run through Central Park to clear my mind. Typically, I'm most active online during late evenings after work hours.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: While I have a solid foundation in technology due to my degree in computer science and my work as a web developer, my knowledge of fertility and health topics comes from personal experience and self-research. My partner and I are currently trying to conceive, so I've been delving into fertility discussions and medical articles to better understand the process.
